t: The Regulator Tube Module is an $(l:tubes/tube_modules#inline)inline/$ module used to limit the $(l:base_concepts/pressure)pressure/$ allowed through the tube. By default, the module will regulate the pressure to 4.9 bar (for both basic and advanced tubes) with no redstone signal, reducing toward 0 as the signal rises toward 15. This means a lever right beside a regulator closes it, preventing any air flow through it.

调节器管道模块是一种$(l:tubes/tube_modules#inline)内联/$模块，用于限制允许通过管道的$(l:base_concepts/pressure)压力/$。默认情况下，在没有红石信号时，该模块会将压力调节至 4.9 bar（基础管道和高级管道均如此），并会随着信号强度升向 15 而逐渐降低至 0。这意味着，如果在调节器旁边直接放置一个拉杆，它就会关闭，从而阻止任何空气流经它。

When the narrow side of the regulator reaches this pressure, no more air will be allowed through the tube. This principal can be used as a $(thing)transformer/$: on the input (wide) side is high-pressure air, but the Regulator Tube limits the pressure on the output to the threshold pressure.$(p)This allows a lower tier tube network to be safely supplied by a higher-tier network.
当调节管较窄一侧达到这个压力时，空气就不再能通过管道。这个原理可以用作$(thing)变压器/$：输入（较宽）的一侧是高压空气，而调节管会将输出压力限制在阈值压力。$(p)这样就能让低等级的管道网络安全地由更高等级的网络供气。

Interestingly, the $(thing)Regulator Module/$ allows unrestricted flow of air in the opposite direction (from the narrow side to the wide side) regardless of the redstone signal; this means a regulator with a full redstone signal can be used as a one-way valve.$(p)Note that the $(thing)Regulator/$ does $(italic)not/$ actively reduce pressure on its narrow side; it only prevents air flow if the pressure would rise above the threshold.
有趣的是，$(thing)调节器模块/$无论红石信号如何，都会允许空气沿相反方向（从窄侧流向宽侧）不受限制地流动；这意味着，一个接收到完整红石信号的校准器可以用作单向阀。$(p)请注意，$(thing)校准器/$$(italic)不会/$主动降低其窄侧的压力；如果压力将会上升到超过阈值，它只会阻止空气流动。

Applying a $(l:tubes/module_expansion_card)Module Expansion Card/$ to the Regulator Module unlocks a GUI providing far more control over the threshold level. You can set a precise threshold in the GUI, or (with the $(bold)Advanced Config/$ checkbox) configure interpolated threshold levels based on the redstone signal. This works exactly like the $(l:tubes/safety_module)Safety Module/$.
将$(l:tubes/module_expansion_card)模块拓展卡/$安装到调节器模块上后，会解锁一个 GUI，让你能对阈值进行更精细的控制。你可以在 GUI 中设置精确阈值，或者勾选$(bold)高级配置/$，根据红石信号来配置插值阈值。这与$(l:tubes/safety_module)安全模块/$的工作方式完全相同。
